entities.summary: Sir William Flood Webb was an Australian lawyer. He was the Chief Justice of Queensland and a judge of Australia's Federal Supreme Court, the High Court of Australia. He was appointed President of the International Military Tribunal for the Far East by General Douglas MacArthur, commonly known as the Tokyo trial, after the end of World War II.
